text:
Seattle na-eso mmezi ya na-adịgide adịgide na-abụghị nke ụmụ amaala ruo Alki Point na 1851. E tinyere obodo ahụ na 14 January 1865, akwụkwọ ikike ahụ kagburu na 1867, ma Seattle tinyeghachiri ya na 2 December 1869.

Taa Seattle bụ obodo kachasị ukwuu na Washington State na gafee Pacific Northwest, nke dị na Puget Sound. A maara ya dị ka Emerald City, ọ bụ nnukwu ebe tech, aerospace na ụgbọ mmiri, ebe Boeing nọ n'ime ụlọ ọrụ ya na-akọwapụta. Lumen Field dị na mpaghara SoDo, dị nso na etiti obodo.

Obodo ahụ nwere otu n'ime omenala bọọlụ miri emi na United States. Seattle Sounders FC agbaala na MLS kemgbe 2009 ma na-adọta mgbe niile n'ime igwe mmadụ kachasị ukwuu na otu. Ndị otu ndị na-akwado ha na-akwado ha nke ọma, Emerald City Supporters, Gorilla FC, Eastside Supporters na North End Faithful, nke omenala tifo na abụ ha na-atụnyere mgbe ụfọdụ na European ultras. Ndị Sounders rere oge mbụ ha na MLS ma wuo ndepụta nchere tiketi oge ngwa ngwa, ihe ịrịba ama nke ọchịchọ nke na-adịghị ajụ kemgbe ahụ.

Egwuregwu ọkachamara na Seattle abụghị naanị ndị Sounders. Obodo ahụ bụkwa ebe NWSL Seattle Reign FC, nke agbaala na Lumen Field kemgbe 2022 ma gbanwee aha ya site na OL Reign laghachi Seattle Reign FC na January 2024. Ọnụnọ abụọ ahụ, bọọlụ ụmụ nwoke na ụmụ nwanyị na-ekerịta otu ala, na-eme ka kalenda nke egwuregwu ọkwa dị elu miri emi nke ole na ole obodo America nwere ike iṅomi.

Ọnụ ọgụgụ nke nkwado ahụ na-egosi na akwụkwọ ndekọ. Ndị Sounders setịpụrụ ndekọ ịbịanụ otu egwuregwu nke 69,314 na Leagues Cup 2025 Final na 31 August 2025, mmeri 3-0 megide Inter Miami CF. Ọ bụ ụdị ọnụ ọgụgụ na-akọwa ihe mere Seattle ji nweta òkè nke asọmpi kachasị ukwuu n'ụwa: obodo ebe bọọlụ na-ejupụta nnukwu stadium ọ bụghị dị ka ihe ọhụrụ kama dị ka ihe a na-eme mgbe niile, na ebe omenala ndị na-akwado ya etoola ka ọ bụrụ otu n'ime ndị na-eme mkpọtụ na nke kacha nwee mmasị na North American soccer.
